title: mailin Enterprise (com.ecosanskriti.mailin.enterprise)
description: Managed settings for mailin Enterprise. Upload in Jamf Pro ▸ Configuration Profiles ▸ Application & Custom Settings ▸ External Applications ▸ Custom Schema, with the preference domain com.ecosanskriti.mailin.enterprise. See ENTERPRISE_DEPLOYMENT.md.

orgName.title: Organization name
orgName.description: Shown in About and on every report and receipt.

examinerName.title: Examiner name
examinerName.description: The person's name on audit entries and sealed receipts, e.g. $FULLNAME.

role.title: Role
role.description: viewer: read and search. reviewer: + tag, code, annotate. examiner: + import, export, print, legal holds, productions. administrator: + permanent deletion, releasing holds, modules, restore, license. An unknown value is treated as viewer.

licenseKey.title: License key
licenseKey.description: The MAILIN1.… key issued for your organization.

allowConnectedMail.title: Allow Live Mail
allowConnectedMail.description: false: the Live Mail page and every mail connection are off; nothing connects to a mail server.

allowedMailProviders.title: Allowed mail providers
allowedMailProviders.description: Leave empty or unset for all. imap = any other IMAP server. An account of another provider gets no network; its saved mail stays.

allowServerChanges.title: Allow changing mail on the server
allowServerChanges.description: false: mailin never moves, flags or deletes mail on the server.

syncOnlyOnWiFi.title: Automatic sync only on Wi-Fi or a wired network

maxDownloadMBps.title: Highest average download speed (MB/s)
maxDownloadMBps.description: The person may choose a lower limit, never a higher one.
